text:
英语词汇 · 专四 · 第 28 单元

tattered
音标：英 /ˈtætəd/  美 /'tætɚd/
adj. 破旧的
例句：He produced a tattered envelope from his pocket.
他从口袋里掏出一个破烂的信封。

tease
音标：英 /ti:z/  美 /tiz/
v. 戏弄，取笑
例句：Don’t get upset. I was only teasing .
别生气，我只是在逗你玩。
例句：He used to tease her mercilessly .
他过去总是无情地取笑她。

trumpet
音标：英 /ˈtrʌmpɪt/  美 /'trʌmpɪt/
n. 喇叭
例句：Life is something like a trumpet.
生活有点像一个喇叭。

whistle
音标：英 /ˈwɪsl/  美 /'wɪsl/
n. 口哨
短语：blow the whistle — 告发；揭发
短语：clean as a whistle — 擦得净亮
例句：The lifeguard blew his whistle.
救生员吹响哨子。

assume
音标：英 /əˈsju:m/  美 /ə'sum/

短语：subjective assume — 主观臆断
例句：I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。
例句：When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

bargain
